title: Owner approval ledger line (factory/approvals.py, F-63)
description: One line of <factory_root>/approvals/<project>.jsonl. The ledger is the source of approval truth: outside every repo and sandbox, append-only and hash-chained the way progress.py chains. This schema is the per-line backstop the loader enforces (F-02 rule) on top of the chain: a line that is valid JSON and chains correctly but has the wrong shape refuses the load with the line named.

n.description: Entry number; set by the ledger, must equal the line number.

prev.description: SHA-256 of the previous line (genesis 0*64 for line 1); set by the ledger.

kind.description: task: this exact contract (contract_hash) is approved to act on. profile: these per-group hashes of the profile's security-relevant content are approved. escalation_waiver (F-72): the owner accepted ONE escalation class on ONE exact PR head SHA — the key (task_id, escalation, sha) a recover --accept re-run checks; a different SHA, class or contract voids it.

project.description: The project this approval binds to; must equal the file's own project — a ledger copied from another project's file refuses to load.

task_id.description: kind=task and kind=escalation_waiver: the task's id.

contract_hash.description: kind=task: factory.contract.contract_hash(task) at approval time. kind=escalation_waiver: the contract hash the accept judged — a contract changed since the escalation is a different contract and needs its own acceptance.

groups.description: kind=profile: group name -> SHA-256 of that group's canonical content (a missing key hashes as null). Group names: factory.approvals.PROFILE_SECURITY_GROUPS.

escalation.description: kind=escalation_waiver: the ONE class waived (F-72 AC-4 — the only two classes recover --accept answers).

sha.description: kind=escalation_waiver: the exact PR head SHA the waiver covers; any new commit on the branch voids it.

released_sha.description: kind=escalation_waiver, optional (F-72 R2-F1 guard 2): the clean commit the accept released (same parent, same tree, no [skip ci], lease-pushed) — the sweep's waiver match accepts it as the same acceptance; any other new commit matches neither and voids the waiver.

evidence.description: kind=escalation_waiver: what the owner checked before accepting.
